title: Proper Fractions, Improper Fractions and Mixed Numbers

trainers.instruction: Fill in the gaps using the diagram.

atoms.b: The ((numerator ++denominator fraction_line)) indicates how many equal parts the whole is divided into. It is found at the ((top ++bottom)) of the fraction.
The ((++numerator denominator fraction_line)) indicates how many parts of the whole there are. It is found at the ((++top bottom)) of the fraction.

trainers.instruction: Fill in the gaps using the diagram.

atoms.b: Fractions where the numerator is smaller than the denominator are called ((proper_fractions)).
Fractions where the numerator is larger than or equal to the denominator are called ((improper_fractions)).
Numbers that consist of a whole number and a proper fraction are called ((mixed_numbers)).
